title: Ell-adic completion preserves exactness of a short sequence of abelian groups under a finiteness hypothesis
author: Cyril Demarche; David Harari
work: Duality for complexes of tori over a global field of positive characteristic
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 7 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.129
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes an exact sequence of abelian groups A -> B -> E -> 0 and states that the induced map B^(ell) -> E^(ell) on ell-adic completions is surjective, and that if the ell-torsion of E (or the quotient A/ell) is finite then A^(ell) -> B^(ell) -> E^(ell) -> 0 is again exact (statement lines 1074-1087). The proof first exploits right exactness of tensoring with Z/ell^m to get surjectivity of the maps on the kernels of the completed sequence, and then replaces A by the image I of A -> B so that the snake lemma can be applied and projective limits taken along the finite quotients _{ell^m}E (proof lines 1093-1125). The step that cannot be done by a single cited theorem is the middle one: passing to the projective limit requires the finiteness of the ell-power torsion for every m, which the author proves by an explicit induction using the short exact sequences _{ell}E -> _{ell^{m+1}}E -> _{ell^m}E. Both hypotheses of the second part are used in the proof, and the two cases are handled separately. H2.
